games.title: Language Choice
games.description: Choose the form that makes the unit language accurate.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence gives the reason using to and a base verb?
choices: We wash the fruit for clean.
We wash the fruit before removing pesticide.
We wash the fruit to remove pesticide.
We wash the fruit so clean it.
rounds.answer: We wash the fruit to remove pesticide.
rounds.explanation: Only this sentence uses to plus the base verb remove, which is how the infinitive of purpose gives a reason.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence is a correct imperative for a food-safety poster?
choices: You wash the fruit before eating.
The fruit is washed by you.
Washing the fruit is important for everyone.
Wash the fruit before you eat it.
rounds.answer: Wash the fruit before you eat it.
rounds.explanation: An imperative starts with the base verb and leaves out the subject you.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence compares two kinds of bread correctly?
choices: Fresh bread is better than old bread.
Fresh bread is more good than old bread.
Fresh bread is gooder than old bread.
Fresh bread is the most good bread.
rounds.answer: Fresh bread is better than old bread.
rounds.explanation: Good has the special comparison form better, and a comparison needs than to join the two things.

games.title: Reading Detective
games.description: Use unit evidence to solve each reading clue.

rounds.prompt: Which two places does the food pass through before it finally reaches your home?
choices: It travels to the market and then the bakery before it reaches your home.
The rule is “You must be more careful” and the possibility is “Old food might make you very sick”.
The meat was not fresh, and Doctor Sarah blamed chemicals used to clean old meat that were not washed off.
rounds.answer: It travels to the market and then the bakery before it reaches your home.
rounds.explanation: The text lists the journey in order: the market first, the bakery next, and home last.

rounds.prompt: Which three foods does The Market Song ask you to gather with care?
choices: The rule is “You must be more careful” and the possibility is “Old food might make you very sick”.
She writes that farmers must use less pesticide and that people must wash their food with care.
The song names rice, lamb and fresh green peas.
rounds.answer: The song names rice, lamb and fresh green peas.
rounds.explanation: The three foods appear in the opening line, joined by and before the word gather.

rounds.prompt: Why did the sandwich make Amal ill, and what did Doctor Sarah say caused it?
choices: She chooses only what looks clean and safe, because her illness taught her to check food first.
The meat was not fresh, and Doctor Sarah blamed chemicals used to clean old meat that were not washed off.
The song names rice, lamb and fresh green peas.
rounds.answer: The meat was not fresh, and Doctor Sarah blamed chemicals used to clean old meat that were not washed off.
rounds.explanation: Omar warns about the meat early on, and the doctor names the unwashed cleaning chemicals later.

games.title: Question Quest
games.description: Read each unit question carefully and choose the best answer.

rounds.prompt: Choose the missing word from The Market Song: “Rice and ______ and fresh green peas, gather them with care, if you please!”
rounds.answer: lamb
rounds.explanation: The song lists three foods, and only lamb is a food that fits between rice and green peas.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence uses must correctly to give a rule?
choices: You must to wash the fruit.
rounds.answer: You must wash the fruit.
rounds.explanation: After must we use the base verb on its own, with no to, no -ing and no -s.

rounds.prompt: Which helping verb correctly begins this question: ______ your brother like rice?
rounds.answer: Does
rounds.explanation: Your brother is one person, so the question needs does with the base verb like.

games.title: Unit Mission
games.description: Finish with a mixed challenge across the whole unit.

rounds.prompt: Which word means a time when many people do not have enough food?
rounds.answer: famine
rounds.explanation: A famine is a shortage of food, while a bakery is a shop, a spice is a flavouring and a comma is a punctuation mark.

rounds.prompt: Which word names the chemical a farmer sprays to kill insects on crops?
rounds.answer: pesticide
rounds.explanation: Pesticide is sprayed on plants; a stomach is a body part, a comma is a punctuation mark and labour is hard work.

rounds.prompt: Amal had to chew the dried meat for a long time. Which unit word describes it?
rounds.answer: chewy
rounds.explanation: Chewy means hard to bite, so it fits meat that needs long chewing; fresh, deadly and famine describe other things.
